description: 臺中都會區大眾捷運系統藍線建設計畫大事紀 (機電科業務範圍) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府捷運工程局. 臺中都會區大眾捷運系統藍線建設計畫重要事件日期紀錄 (機電科業務範圍). Coverage: 臺中市政府捷運工程局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府捷運工程局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
